overview_description.description:
Codingal is on a mission to provide coding education to every K-12 student.

Coding helps improve logical thinking and problem-solving skills by 70% among kids at a young age, also enabling them to perform better in other subjects in school. Moreover, coding jobs are the future. They already constitute more than 60% of all jobs in science, technology, engineering, and math. While still in school, those who start young will be ahead of everyone by the time they get into college. They will be creators of the future. Learning to code at a young age will inspire more kids, including girls, to take up Computer Science as a major when entering college.

Today, schools and traditional education systems are not equipped to provide the right coding education to children. Codingal is here to change that and empower every student with the tools, content, and live coding classes to start learning to code and build anything they can imagine.

product.name: Coding Grandmaster
product.description: A comprehensive coding course for grades 1-10 teaching app, game, and website development through 144 lessons and 350+ activities.

product.name: Coding Prodigy
product.description: A 96-lesson coding curriculum for grades 1-12 focused on mastering coding skills and creating apps and games.

product.name: Coding Champion
product.description: A beginner-friendly coding course for grades 1-12 with 48 lessons and 50+ activities to build apps, games, and websites.

product.name: Scratch Programming
product.description: A block-based coding course for grades 1-8 teaching game, animation, and AI basics through 36 lessons and 50+ activities.

product.name: Game Development for Kids
product.description: An online course for grades 4-8 teaching game design, storytelling, and programming using Scratch and JavaScript over 36 lessons.

product.name: App Development for Kids (Thunkable)
product.description: A course for grades 4-8 teaching app creation and publishing using Thunkable with 36 lessons and 40+ activities.
